items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But Wynton has since come to me and approached me on doing some other things.

ctx.x: Did that satisfy that need? Or was that just whetting the appetite for an expanded presentation of Jackie’s music?

Yeah, it whet my appetite. If it never happened again, then I was just happy that it happened that one time. But Wynton has since come to me and approached me on doing some other things. I just haven’t had time to do them with.
